name: suede-marketing-ideas
description: Suede-affiliated marketing ideation using a structured tactic library scored for stage, audience fit, evidence, capacity, cost, and risk. Use when the user is stuck, wants options, or needs a shortlist of growth tactics before committing to a plan. NOT FOR: a comprehensive roadmap (use suede-marketing-plan), channel execution (use the relevant public Suede skill), or unattended recurring workflows (use suede-marketing-loops).
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 围绕目标阶段和受众，从结构化营销策略库中筛选并评估增长点，适合陷入瓶颈、需要备选方案或确定执行优先级时使用。
